meta.name: render-ig-live-gallery
meta.description: Render an 'Instagram-Live social-proof gallery' video from a config — ~5 real brand product stills each framed as an Instagram-LIVE card (IG gradient-ring avatar, username, verified check, red LIVE badge, viewer count, close X, a short claim-free live-comment feed, an empty 'Add a comment…' bar, and reaction hearts floating up the right edge), with a brand-approved benefit sentence building one phrase per slide and a clean logo endcard, rendered deterministically with PIL frames plus FFmpeg — FREE (the music bed comes from create-music-elevenlabs), products and wordmark stay crisp. Use for the ig-live-gallery format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品图片渲染为Instagram直播风格画廊视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量生成品牌产品展示视频用于社交媒体营销。
copy.tagline_en: Render product images into Instagram-Live style gallery videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch-produce branded product showcase videos for social media.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以根据配置生成一段 Instagram 直播风格的画廊视频，展示真实产品图片，并配上评论、点赞动画和品牌标语。
howto.when: 当你提供产品图片、品牌信息和配置参数，并要求生成 ig-live-gallery 格式视频时触发。

say.text: 用这些产品图片生成一个 IG 直播画廊视频。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供配置文件和图片目录。

say.text: 为我的护肤品牌创建一个 Instagram 直播风格的宣传视频。
say.note: 需要提供品牌信息和产品图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an Instagram-Live style gallery video from a config, displaying real product images with comments, reaction hearts, and brand benefit text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide product images, brand info, and configuration parameters, and ask to generate an ig-live-gallery format video.

say_en.text: Generate an IG live gallery video using these product images.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for config file and assets directory.

say_en.text: Create an Instagram-Live style promo video for my skincare brand.
say_en.note: Requires brand info and product images.
